notes: Both flagged fusions are retained: לִפְנֵי → *before* is rule 30's and rule 23's standing case, headed on the construct noun; כָּל ... יָּמִים → *always* meets the one-English-word condition with the separately segmented article kept out, as in the chronicles example.
The head of *always* is contested between the governing quantifier and the noun carrying the temporal lexeme, and the unit's note records it.

*cause ... to dwell* is one Piel infinitive's rendering, discontinuous around the object and headed on the complement verb under rule 44; each coordinated rectum takes its own written *of* under rules 19 and 25.
